text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.2183 for the Software Engineer (Front-end) position. The strongest evidence for their application includes experience with "JavaScript", "Node.js", and "AWS". Key gaps include missing requirements for typescript, prototyping tools, react, redux, sass/css, responsive/adaptive design, and animation library. Despite the low fit and missing must-have skills, the application has been escalated for further review.
